summary.plain: A French experiment that watched antineutrinos from the Chooz nuclear reactors with two detectors at different distances, finding evidence that they change type on the way.
summary.technical: Reactor-antineutrino oscillation experiment at the Chooz nuclear power plant, France, with detectors at 400 m and 1050 m from the reactor cores; its 2012 far-detector-only result found sin²(2θ₁₃) = 0.109±0.030(stat)±0.025(syst), excluding no-oscillation at 2.9σ. Both detectors ran 2015-2017.
